availability.note: Geely AU Build & Price lists exactly two grades, Complete $41,990 and Inspire $45,990, on the research date; CarExpert 2027 model page agrees on two grades.

listPrice.note: $41,990 'before on-road costs' (CarExpert news, 2 Mar 2026; zecar likewise); Geely AU configurator shows $41,990 without basis wording on the research date. CarExpert's $46,267 is a Sydney drive-away.

batteryKwh.note: Usable. EV Database (UK EX5, same 68.4 kWh LFP pack) gives nominal 70.0 / usable 68.4 kWh; CarExpert AU spec page labels 68.39 kWh usable.

rangeKm.note: 475 km WLTP on 18-inch wheels (CarExpert 2027 spec page; Geely AU configurator '475km WLTP'). Direction test: no higher than the UK WLTP figures for the same pack, so not an NEDC submission.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: Geely WLTP combined consumption as quoted by CarExpert (wall-to-wheel, hence above battery/range = 14.4).

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 410 L total in a two-layer boot (CarsGuide; CarExpert review 302-410 L). 302 L is above the false floor 'to lower window' (CarExpert spec page); the ~108 L lower layer is a lift-floor well usable with the new cargo blind in place, so the total is kept. UK EV Database gives 461 L.

seats.note: Rear bench seating capacity 3 plus two front seats.

towKg.note: No braked or unbraked rating listed; trailer noseweight 0 kg. Not rated to tow in Australia; the UK-market car is rated 750 kg braked (EV Database) but no AU rating exists.

warrantyYears.note: 84 months / unlimited km whole vehicle, no servicing condition (private use); battery 96 months / unlimited km to 70%. Roadside assist 7 years only if serviced in the Geely network.

insuranceAnnual.note: Kept from held data; anchored to byd-atto3-evo-dynamic ($41,990, 1600), byd-atto3-evo-premium ($46,990, 1700) and geely-starray-em-i-inspire-awd ($44,990, 1700).

depreciationCurve.note: Geely brand convention shared with geely-starray-em-i: steeper than the mainstream default for a brand with ~2 years of Australian sales, repeated campaign discounting ($500 factory bonus plus 0.68% finance Black Friday offer on geely.com.au/ex5) and no resale record.
